notes: Words used the same way everywhere: a “display” is the Corsair XENEON EDGE, tablet or computer showing the dashboard; a “screen” is a page of widgets
HouseRunner is the product name everywhere – the licence, privacy notice, emails and your Google Sheet’s menu (now 🏠 HouseRunner)
The website is called houserunner.app throughout (no more “Configurator”), and the Google side is always “your Google Sheet” and “the Google script”
Rewards everywhere: Family Admin’s Points button is now Rewards, and the child’s widget is “Child’s Rewards”
The Corsair XENEON EDGE always has its full name; connecting one is always “Connect a display”, with the same device names in the Setup wizard and on Home
System: Software Licence is now Licence, Screen Sleep is Display Sleep; menu groups renamed (Support, Set up rewards)
Every page without a left-hand menu has a folded ℹ️ “How … works” box; pick-one buttons all look like the Lists page; Save and + Add buttons say what they save or add
The same simple header on Help, the licence, privacy, What’s new, pairing and Windows pages
One green, one red and one amber across the website, phone apps and dashboard; colour stripes on rows; a boxed ✕ that turns red
Adding an event shows the chosen date the family’s way (e.g. Sun 15 Nov)
